::: {#thm-slr-additive}
#### Additive form of the conditional Gaussian model

In a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian),
each outcome is its conditional mean plus its deviation (@def-slr-deviation):

$$Y_i = \mean_i + \cdev_i.$$
:::

::: proof
This is the solution to @exr-slr-additive.
:::
